label: UniFi Express (UX) AX3000 cloud gateway
description: Ubiquiti UniFi Express (UX) - Wi-Fi 6 AX3000 dual-band cloud gateway with a built-in 2x2 access point (2.4 GHz 574 Mbps, 5 GHz 2.4 Gbps) and exactly two wired ports: one 1G WAN and one 1G LAN. It is managed through UniFi Network rather than a local CLI, and the single LAN port means any switch hangs off that one link.
notes:
Census from the vendor tech-spec table, read 2026-11-19 at https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/cloud-gateways/ux (HTTP 200, 670,206 B, server-rendered; the structured table, not the rendered images): "Max. WAN Port Count = 1", "Default WAN Ports = (1) GbE RJ45", "Port Layout = 2 (1G/100M/10M)", "Throughput 5 GHz = 2.4 Gbps / 2.4 GHz = 573.5 Mbps" (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax, 2x2 MU-MIMO), "Max. Power Consumption = 10W", "Power Method = USB type C (5V DC/3A)". No SFP/slot and no PoE on this model - the row declares neither. The sourceUrl this row carried until today, https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/unifi-cloud-gateways/ux, answers 307 with Location https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/cloud-gateways and a 21-byte body (measured 2026-11-19, no redirect followed): it was the category index, not the product page, so the two wired ports had no page behind them. The corrected path answers 200 with the census above, and is the URL every other UniFi gateway row in this directory already uses.
Power: none of these copper ports accepts PoE. Vendor page https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/cloud-gateways/ux (HTTP 200, 670,206 B, read 2026-11-19, server-rendered tech-spec table) says "Power Method = USB type C (5V DC/3A)"; a box fed from mains, a USB-C supply or a DC jack has no PoE-PD front end, so wan / lan now declare poeIn: false. Without that declaration the engine's isPoePd() match on "unifi" gave each silent copper port a 12.95 W 802.3af draw - the defect PR #2118 and PR #2121 fixed across the UXG family (refs #130).
